name: Enosh (Seth's son)
title: The first to call on the name of the Lord
summary: Enosh was the son of Seth and the grandson of Adam. He is significant in the Bible because it was during his time that people began to call on the name of the Lord, marking the beginning of organized worship of God. His name means 'human' or 'mortal' in Hebrew.

keyEvents.title: Enosh is born
keyEvents.description: Seth had a son named Enosh when he was 105 years old. Enosh was born into the godly line from Adam through Seth.

keyEvents.title: The Beginning of Calling on the Name of the Lord
keyEvents.description: In Enosh's time, people began to call on the name of the Lord. This marks an important milestone in humanity's spiritual history and worship of God.

keyEvents.title: Enosh Has a Son Named Kenan
keyEvents.description: When Enosh was 90 years old, he had a son named Kenan, who continued the messianic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Enosh Mentioned in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Enosh is included in Luke's genealogy showing Jesus' ancestry all the way back to Adam, confirming his place in salvation history.
